content.text:
Done. Three things changed:

**1. Voice no longer requires sign-in** (`src/utils/speech.ts`)

The chain is now BYOK → hosted (only when there's an account) → the browser's own `speechSynthesis` → configuration error. Previously any BYOK gap fell straight into the Pro-gated Convex action, which threw `Not signed in` — the error you saw. A hosted refusal (not Pro, rate-limited, no hosted key) now falls through to the local voice instead of ending the read. `stopSpeech()` cancels local speech too.

**2. The actual reason BYOK wasn't used** (`src/utils/idb.ts`, `src/utils/ai-orchestrator.ts`)

`getCachedAiSettings()` memoises AI settings for the life of the page, and *nothing ever invalidated it* — `invalidateAiSettingsCache()` had no callers outside its own test. A key added on the Settings route was invisible to every feature until a full reload, so `hasConfiguredVoiceProvider()` said "no provider" and the code fell to the hosted path. `saveAiSettingsToIdb` now emits `twyne:ai-settings-saved` and the orchestrator invalidates on it. This affected every BYOK feature, not just voice.

**3. Voice icons in the editor's passage modals** (`twyne-editor.tsx`)

`SpeakButton` added to the persona-note popover, the suggestion modal, and the writer's inline-comment modal. The inline cards only know their author as a DOM-attribute string, so `SpeakRequest` gained `author` — `speech.ts` resolves that name against the cast (IDB, falling back to defaults) to fill in the persona's voice, per-provider voice ids, and lore instructions.

**Also — the `<think>` tag request:** the retry existed but only fired when stripping left *nothing*. Now any reply containing reasoning tags is discarded and regenerated once with the nudge, in both `src/utils/ai-client.ts` (BYOK) and `convex/agents.ts` (both server paths). Fallback order never surfaces a literal `<think>`: clean retry → stripped original → stripped retry → markers removed.

Typecheck (app + convex) and lint are clean. New tests cover the signed-out hosted skip, the signed-in hosted call, and `hasReasoningTags`/`removeReasoningTagMarkers`. One full-suite failure remains (`idb-preferences`) — it's the known cross-file localStorage interference and fails on `main` the same way; the file passes alone.

One thing I did not change: `convex/voice.ts` still requires sign-in and Pro. That's correct for a path spending your hosted OpenAI key — the fix was to stop the client from walking into it.
the other thing is that I would like the responses streamed rather than just waiting all at once for the text
Let me look at how generation currently flows to the UI before choosing where streaming fits.
